items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Pete Johnson playing at the Lone Star; Interviewee confirms Pete Johnson was well known by then and discusses piano battles involving Everett Johnson and Pete Johnson, but does not describe a personal or professional relationship with Pete Johnson himself.

ctx.x: And so all the musicians would meet there. And now, directly across from Sunset was the Lone Star, where Pete Johnson was playing, later joined by Joe Turner, you see.
Lone Star, that was what--a bar?
